question.prompt: When the global search field is focused and a search overlay is active, what should one Escape keypress dismiss?

options.label: Overlay else focus
options.detail: Assume Escape closes the search overlay when it is open; if no overlay is open, Escape clears field focus.

options.label: Dismiss both
options.detail: Assume one Escape keypress closes the overlay and clears field focus together.

options.label: Focus only
options.detail: Assume Escape clears only field focus and does not dismiss an active overlay.

options.label: Need source
options.detail: Another source is needed to define the single-Escape outcome.

content.risk_rationale: The PRD says “Escape clears focus/search overlay” but does not define the branch behavior for focus-only versus overlay-active states; scenario count and test assertions change depending on that rule.
